facts.value: As part of your studies in another department, you can complete certain modules in our Department of Economics, known as export modules of the Department of Economics - these also include optional modules. This is only possible based on existing cooperation agreements between the departments.

For the study programs of other departments, an overview is provided that assembles which export modules you can register for in the Department of Economics and how you can incorporate these export modules into your program in your department.

Furthermore, you cannot incorporate any other modules from the Department of Economics into your program in another department and also cannot earn differing credit points (CP) at the Department of Economics.
